info.name: Query Location
info.description:
# Description Query Location API is available to provide information regarding Bunnings locations across AU and NZ. ## Getting Started 1. Populate the collection variables with your Consumer Key (`clientId`) and Consumer Secret (`clientSecret`) 2. In the collection's Authorization section, use the *Get New Access Token* button to get an access token, then click *Use Token* so it can be used in subsequent requests. ## Environments We have three environments to help you develop your applications and safely interface with our APIs. You can use the three environments as part of your SDLC in progressing your application from sandbox, to test to our live APIs. Check the collection variables to set the correct `baseUrl` and `authenticationURL` to match the environment for your API keys. | **Environment** | **URLs** | | --- | --- | | **Sandbox** | AuthN URL: [https://connect.sandbox.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token](https://connect.sandbox.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token)

Base URL: [https://location.sandbox.api.bunnings.com.au/location](https://location.sandbox.api.bunnings.com.au/location) | | **Test** | AuthN URL: [https://authorisation-stg.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token](https://authorisation-stg.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token)

Base URL: [https://location.stg.api.bunnings.com.au/location](https://location.stg.api.bunnings.com.au/location) | | **Live** | AuthN URL: [https://authorisation.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token](https://authorisation.api.bunnings.com.au/connect/token)

Base URL: [https://location.api.bunnings.com.au/location](https://location.api.bunnings.com.au/location) | ## Security Depending on the scope held, more or less functionality is available at an endpoint. There are further access controls in place to ensure the scope of the Query Location functionality is within a bounds suitable for the client making the request. ### loc:pub Querying common Bunnings locations information ##HATEOAS The Query Location is built following the HATEOAS guidelines. When using the API, the client should start by first calling the `discovery` operation to get a list of possible links these links can then be followed to perform functions. If no correlation token is provided when using this service, it will generate a token for you in the header response. Contact Support: Name: Developer Support Email: [developer@bunnings.com.au](mailto:developer@bunnings.com.au)

item.name: Provides search functionality against locations. (Auth loc:pub)

header.description: (Required) The API version the client is calling this endpoint at. When calling this api the client must provided the version of the api they have been written against this allows the api to correctly support the calling clients. Clients are still required to support non breaking changes within the same version

query.description: Optional continuation token that allows for paging to the next result set.

Filter can be optionally used to filter out entities of the collection. 
A filter is comprised of one or more expressions joined with the following logical operators listed bellow in precedence order.

*Allowed Logical Operators*
 * `(<expression>)`
 * `not <expression>`
 * `<expression> and <expression>`
 * `<expression> or <expression>`


The filter can not exceed a maximum of 3 complexity which is a sum of the complexity of each expression in the filter.
Expressions match one of the bellow patterns

**Basic Filters**
|Complexity|Property|Operators|ValueRegex|Description|
|----------|---------|---------|----------|-----------|
|1|state|Equal|('(?:[^']|'')*')||
|1|locationCode|Equal|('(?:[^']|'')*')||
|1|countryCode|Equal|('(?:[^']|'')*')||
|1|isStore|Equal|(true|false)||

*Matching Regex Patterns*:
 * (?'property'[sS][tT][aA][tT][eE]) (?'operation'eq) (?'value''(?:[^']|'')*')
 * (?'property'[lL][oO][cC][aA][tT][iI][oO][nN][cC][oO][dD][eE]) (?'operation'eq) (?'value''(?:[^']|'')*')
 * (?'property'[cC][oO][uU][nN][tT][rR][yY][cC][oO][dD][eE]) (?'operation'eq) (?'value''(?:[^']|'')*')
 * (?'property'[iI][sS][sS][tT][oO][rR][eE]) (?'operation'eq) (?'value'true|false)

*Allowed Operators*
 * Equal = `<property> eq <value>`


Sample filter: $filter=name eq 'Bob' and (address/state in ['WA','VIC'] or age gt 10)

Order By can be optionally used to control the sequence the entities of the collection are returned in.
This collection can have a maximum of 1 order properties separated by a ',' character.
Sorting can be done in asc or desc order by following the property name by a space and then the key words asc or desc.
If no direction is specified then asc is assumed.
This collection can be sorted by the following properties:
 - countryCode
 - locationCode
 - state
example: $orderby=name desc,address/state asc.

skip can be used to skip the first n number of results of the sequences of entities of the collection.

example: $skip=5

top can be used to take the first n number of results of the sequences of entities of the collection. the maximum value for top is 1000

example: $top=5

response.name: Success
